snippet.title: Kitten Airsoft Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Cute cats. Real airsoft vibes.

Kitten Airsoft is a 2D top-down multiplayer airsoft game where cartoon
kittens settle it with water balloons and water blasters. No blood, no
gore — get hit and you're out until the next round, exactly like paintball.

Download free on Windows: https://kittenairsoft.itch.io/kittenairsoft
Website: https://kittenairsoft.com

── 11 GAME MODES ──────────────────────

BIG FIELD BATTLES
• Kitty Skirmish — 30v30 team elimination
• Kitty Capture the Flag — 30v30, two bases, two flags
• Kitty Center Flag — 30v30 over one neutral flag
• Kitty Commando — 30v30, commanders build and players fight
• Strategy Commander — 60 players, a live war table on top of a real battle

SURVIVAL & ROYALE
• Kitty Waves — 60-player co-op against hundreds of enemies
• Kitty Royale — 30 teams of two, last duo standing

10v10 ARENAS
• Kitty Cat Ball — soccer with a giant yarn ball
• Kitty Speedball Classic — tight bunkers, fast trades
• Kitty Speedball Big Ball — wider field, bigger plays
• Kitty Dodgeball — no flags, no loot, pure dodge energy

── WHAT YOU GET ───────────────────────

20–60 players per match
1–4 player local couch co-op on one screen
2D top-down action
Free to download — name your own price on Itch.io

Strategy on top, real-time chaos underneath. Drop in for minutes
or hours.

Dedicated Official Servers currently US Central only, expanding soon.

───────────────────────────────────────

Made by Kitten Games, LLC
Rated 13+. Online multiplayer with optional in-game purchases.
Support: support@kittenairsoft.com

Music created with Suno AI.
